CYRIS_UI_TOKEN.description: **Required.** The only lock on the triage UI and the vote API. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` — `/login` refuses a secret shorter than 32 characters.

DIGEST_ORIGIN.description: **Required.** The Pages origin this Worker proxies the public archive from, e.g. `https://your-project.pages.dev`. Create the Pages project first — Deploy buttons cannot. Unset, `/` answers 503.

CYRIS_STORE_DATABASE_ID.description: **Required.** The D1 database UUID from `wrangler d1 create cyris` or the dashboard. The container reaches D1 over REST rather than through a binding, so this is an id you paste, not a binding the deploy provisions.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: **Required.** Your account id, shown in the dashboard URL and on any Workers page.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: **Required.** An [API token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with `D1:Edit` and `Cloudflare Pages:Edit`. This is what publishes the digest and reads the store.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_PAGES_PROJECT.description: **Required.** The Pages project name the digest deploys to — the same project `DIGEST_ORIGIN` points at.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: One LLM key is required; set the one matching your provider. [Anthropic Claude](https://console.anthropic.com/).

CYRIS_UI_ACCESS_HOST.description: Optional, and only after Cloudflare Access is verified blocking. The hostname Access is bound to; set it before Access exists and the vote API on that hostname answers 401 to logged-in readers.

CYRIS_WORKER_TOKEN.description: Optional. The one bearer the rss and newsletter Workers accept. Set it here and in those Workers; leave blank to poll feeds directly at digest time.

CYRIS_RSS_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. The `workers/rss/` buffer, e.g. `https://cyris-rss.<sub>.workers.dev`. Blank falls back to polling every feed at digest time, which loses articles a busy feed has already rotated out.

CYRIS_NEWSLETTER_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. The `workers/newsletter/` email ingester. Needs a domain on Cloudflare Email Routing — the one setup step that cannot be automated.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. The `workers/promote/` vote Worker, e.g. `https://cyris-promote.<sub>.workers.dev`. Blank disables the 👍/👎 buttons.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_TOKEN.description: Optional, and **not** a secret: it is rendered into every published digest page so the vote buttons work in a reader's browser. Keep it distinct from `CYRIS_WORKER_TOKEN`.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_CUSTOM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. The hostname readers use, if you attached one. On a domainless deploy set it to this Worker's `*.workers.dev` hostname.

CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. A `Workers AI:Read` token for `@cf/baai/bge-m3` vote-similarity filtering. Not the same token as `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`.

CYRIS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A Discord webhook that gets a line per digest run.
